Guthrie Theater’s Backyard Bash

Sat, Jul 23, 2016 · 7:00 PM – 11:00 PM · Guthrie Theater

When
Sat, Jul 23, 2016 · 7:00 PM – 11:00 PM
Where
Guthrie Theater
818 South 2nd Street,, Minneapolis, MN

Join me for the Guthrie Theater’s Backyard Bash and celebrate summer with the Guthrie! Enjoy drinks in the CHEERS Garden and great eats from the Food Truck Rally*, and bask in the most stunning fireworks display of the year.  The Target Fireworks

Bring your blankets – first 50 on the lawn get a FREE Backyard Bash beach mat! Join us on the West River Parkway lawn and service lot from 7-11 p.m. Fireworks start at 10 p.m.

*Drinks are included in the ticket price. However, Food Truck Rally is pay-as-you-go.
